page: Amazon Web Services c9g.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by custom AWS Graviton arm64 processors. Running on the Nitro hypervisor, this instance features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs with a single thread per core, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64 architecture and dedicated core allocation provide a high ratio of compute resources to memory, making it a resource-dense option for workloads that do not require x86 compatibility or local storage.

The c9g.2xlarge is designed for compute-intensive workloads that benefit from dedicated physical cores and high clock speeds. Suitable applications include web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and containerized microservices that can run natively on the arm64 architecture.
